verification.note: Manually compared the source overview and full-color 6720×3328 re3mr sheet. The sheet separates top, middle, ground and tunnels panels, so no global affine is applied. Positions retain source-relative anchors using locally matched room walls, stairs, corridor bends and reactor centers. Hand-picked landmark precision is approximately 2–5 target pixels on ground, 5–10 on inset boundaries; this is artwork registration, not independent in-game spawn verification. Five source-unconfirmed spawns remain unconfirmed. The basement body source point lies outside its drawn inset and retains its relative position on shared ghosted ground geometry; source room/title inconsistencies are not repaired.

verification.note: Manually checked all 30 source-relative anchors against full-color native source (4097×2142) and target (7680×4025) artwork. The target redraws labels and rearranges industrial-plant, Fortress, Crackhouse and three-story-dorm floor panels. Individual registrations use matched local building/road geometry or room walls, stairs and corridor partitions; no whole-image scale is applied. Shared local roof correspondences preserve the Company Director and rafters close pairs where upstream labels obscure target interiors. Hand-picked wall/corner precision is estimated at 2–6 target pixels; this is visual registration uncertainty, not a measured global affine residual or independent in-game spawn verification. All source floors, titles, photo links and verification statuses remain unchanged, including inconsistent titles and the two-story-dorm guard-room label changing from 106 to 116.
